"Would you go to the festival with me!"

Ah...! Thank you kindly!!
Yay, yaaay...!!

...I-I wanna go buy one. 
Trainer, will you help me pick one out?!

Back then, Yukino Bijin held back, saying
"It's too early for me," but—
T-Together... Together!!

(Kaaah... YESSSS!! I asked them!
I really managed to ask them...! On a date!!)
—Phew. Heheh, I said it!

Even if it's different from the "city girl" she dreams of being,
I can feel how much Yukino Bijin has grown as she tries to move forward.

Even though I'm still so far from bein' a "city girl"...
and haven't grown up at all, still...

I'd wondered what was wrong since she'd seemed so desperate,
so I happily agreed, finding it endearing that she wanted to go to the festival that badly.

(Now I've got nothin' to regret... Wait, no, Yukino!
A date isn't set until they say yes, right?!)

(Training's over, so all that's left is to head back to the lodge,
grab my wallet, and then... and then...)

Ever since I met you, Trainer,
every single day's been super fun!

It's the lipstick promoted by Gold City
that we spotted when we went out together.

...Thinking back on it all, I realize that
this must have been what she was struggling to bring up this whole time.

So I wanted to thank you properly... and show you
how much I've grown thanks to you, but...

Together with a cheerfully beaming Yukino Bijin,
I thoroughly enjoyed the festival stalls.

(It's not just about followin' trends. Someone always pretty, always strong,
who pushes through anything with a smile—)

From before you became my Trainer until now,
you've taught me so much. I'm truly grateful!!

Trainer! Let's go over there next!
Let's have a die-cut candy contest~!!
...Alright!! Trainer!!
...A "city girl" is...
...Yes! Next time, I'll definitely ring one~!
(Someone like that... that's what it meant, right...?)

(I knew it... I'm still nowhere near bein' a "city girl."
...Nowhere near, and yet...)

(Sigh... Even if I'm not a "city girl,"
I thought I could at least show my cool side at a festival...)
Ask you out on... a d-d-date...

Yukino Bijin stands planted firmly right in front of me.
Just as I find myself overwhelmed by her intense aura—
(Even though I'm still so far from bein' a "city girl"...)
Huh...
Today's the day of the big showdown...!

Hehe... I always end up messin' up.
Ah, but today I managed to ask you on a date properly!

(...Whenever Trainer smiles and cheers me on,
it just makes me so happy...)
*Inhaaaale*... *Exhaaaale*...

Yukino Bijin wants to get closer to being a "city girl,"
and needs the confidence to take that first step. If so—

I'm still not confident yet, but...
so I can say I've changed at least a little bit eventually—

...! Ehehe! I can't wait!
I wanna find a shade that suits me... real bad!!

Yukino Bijin looks so overjoyed,
she seems ready to burst into dance at any second.
*Inhale*... *Exhale*...

(...I don't quite get it, but I gotta say thanks. For now,
I'll just have tons of fun and make Trainer smile!)
...Alright, I'm gonna ask them to the festival!!
Would you like to go to the festival with me?!

I can't hide my surprise at realizing she was asking me out on a date...
but right now, I want to acknowledge all the effort Yukino Bijin put in.

Thank you so very much!
I'll keep countin' on ya!
...Phew. Trainer!
Um! ...You see!!

Th-Thank you so kindly...
He-Heheh. You're so nice, Trainer.
Thanks for your hard work!!
(If I walk around lookin' down, everyone else gets down too—...)
...Just gotta do what I can, one step at a time.

(My heart feels all warm, and I get filled with energy...
...Is it really okay for me to stay like this?)

Will lipstick become proof of her growth? No one can say for sure,
but it was undeniably an important first step for Yukino Bijin.
Phew~ That sure was fun~!

Nwaah~! Missed it completely~!
Ring toss is way deeper than it looks...!
